thought.text: The download URLs point to `http://localhost:8000/...`. Now I'll run the full end-to-end validation in a single command: start a local HTTP server for test data, run the documented basic run, then clean up.

reasoning_content:
The distribution's download URL points to `http://localhost:8000/...`, so if we serve `tests/data` on localhost:8000, it should work. Alright, let's do an end-to-end run: start a local HTTP server on port 8000 serving tests/data, then run the documented basic command.

I need to start the server in the background, wait, run the check, and then kill the server. Since shell state doesn't persist across invocations, I'll do it all in a single command using nohup/background + kill at the end.

I'll use a temporary directory for results (e.g., /tmp/validate_results.jsonl), so as not to clutter the workspace... well actually, creating a results file is a normal runtime behavior, but to keep git status clean I'll put it in /tmp.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace/tests/data && python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/tmp/httpd.log 2>&1 &
SRVPID=$!
sleep 2
cd /workspace && timeout 550 python3 -m poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://localhost:8000/catalog.ttl > /tmp/results.jsonl 2>/tmp/check_stderr.log
EC=$?
kill $SRVPID 2>/dev/null
echo "SCRIPT_EXIT=$EC"
echo "---stderr tail---"
tail -5 /tmp/check_stderr.log
echo "---results count---"
wc -l /tmp/results.jsonl
echo "---all lines valid JSON?---"
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
good = bad = 0
lines = open('/tmp/results.jsonl').read().splitlines()
for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
    obj = json.loads(line)  # raises if invalid JSON
    if obj.get("num_good_checks", 0) > obj.get("num_bad_checks", 0):
        good += 1
    else:
        bad += 1
print(f"valid JSON lines: {len(lines)}, good-leaning: {good}, bad-leaning: {bad}")
EOF", "description": "End-to-end run: serve test data, execute documented basic catalog check, validate JSONL output", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Run end-to-end catalog check against local test catalog"}
